# Project instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md` for repository workflow and implementation boundaries.
After bootstrap, all changes reach `main` through a feature/fix/docs branch and a pull request with
the required `validate` check passing. Do not push, merge, or run live subscription operations without
the user's authorization.

This is a Windows PowerShell subscription tool, not a Power BI model or report-authoring harness.
Do not install unrelated agents, skills, hooks or dependencies.
